node.title: Versión del contexto
node.summary: Identify which contextual state informed a representation, rule or decision.

relations: Semantic-window testing could examine when historical product context ceases to be admissible after a material change.
Regime awareness no es forecast ni un remedio general al concept drift. Definir qué cambio invalida qué inferencia antes de medir.
Materialized context and epistemic handoff share a need for explicit validity conditions, although they represent different objects.
Un vector de factores no es un descriptor epistemológico ni resuelve composición entre autoridades. La equivalencia se limita a dependencia contextual explícita.
The Phylons lineage motivates later questions about when a previously useful signal loses its operating-context qualification.
El vínculo registra linaje declarado; no atribuye al sistema de 2018 un detector RA validado en 2026.
A mobility decision should bind regime evidence, control support and permission to the same operation, version and useful time interval.
Diseño propuesto; no se afirma que el producto ya implemente este contrato de composición.
A revision-aware pipeline should bind action to the qualified version it actually relies on, not merely record that a later relabeling occurred.
Comparación retrospectiva; las secuencias del escenario son simbólicas, no episodios observados en Phylons.
For the later mathematical reading, the provenance ledger separates the 2018 heuristics from subsequent sources, derivations and review corrections.
La página capturada conserva una marca de truncamiento; no se afirma que reproduzca íntegramente todas las fuentes técnicas.
